THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
EVERYDAY THEATRE
038
50 / Olive Hosiery
Full-length studio look against a deep olive backdrop:
sleek blonde hair with a center part, oversized white flower
earrings, a fitted ivory turtleneck, a chocolate-brown mini skirt,
sage-green sheer tights and black pointed pumps, with legs
crossed in a poised stance.
51 / Paisley Wrap
A sunlit café portrait: long straight honey-blonde hair,
pale blue-green eyes, a blue satin paisley bandana worn as a cap,
and a white ribbed tank top. A mustard banquette and a white
plaster wall frame the shot.
